meaning:
1) to be great, be majestic, wide, noble (poetic)
1a) (Niphal) majestic, glorious (participle)
1b) (Hiphil) make glorious

elsewhere.note: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.
